description: This file contains the implementation of the SimpleTest framework, including classes for test registry, context, stack trace analysis, and deprecated options, with conditional inclusion of reflection files based on PHP version.

classes.name: SimpleTest
classes.description: Manages global test registry, ignore list, proxy settings, and test context initialization.

classes.name: SimpleTestContext
classes.description: Holds current test, reporter, and resources for a test run.

classes.name: SimpleStackTrace
classes.description: Analyzes PHP stack trace to identify test failure points and relevant method calls.

classes.name: SimpleTestOptions
classes.description: Deprecated class extending SimpleTest with legacy method wrappers.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Reads the SimpleTest version from the VERSION file.

methods.name: ignore
methods.description: Adds a class to the ignore list for tests.

methods.name: ignoreParentsIfIgnored
methods.description: Adds parent classes of ignored classes to the ignore list.

methods.name: isIgnored
methods.description: Checks if a class is in the ignore list.

methods.name: setMockBaseClass
methods.description: Sets the base class for mocks (deprecated).

methods.name: getMockBaseClass
methods.description: Gets the base class for mocks (deprecated).

methods.name: useProxy
methods.description: Sets proxy settings for testing behind a firewall.

methods.name: _getRegistry
methods.description: Internal method to access the global registry of options.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current test run context.
